remarks: Fantastic 1 bedroom condo at desirable Windemere with panoramic downtown views. Modern kitchen with stainless appliances, granite counters and breakfast bar adjoins open living room/dining area combo. Spacious bedroom with good closets, oversized bath, recessed lighting and laminate wood floors throughout. Reserved indoor garage space! Building amenities include gym, common patio area with grills. Cold and hot water included in rent. Enjoy condo living within easy walking distance to vibrant downtown, entertainment, restaurants and train. Agents please read agent remarks regarding application requirements.
